reasoning.text: In the render the exploded floorplan plate, the two memory banks, the twiddle ROM and the die are all the same blue 'glass display' material, so in ISO/TOP the banks and ROM camouflage against the plate and the datapath's storage stages are hard to pick out. The elevation FRONT/SIDE views expose the second real flaw: the exploded plate hangs in a wide empty gap with no visible member connecting it to the die, so it reads as floating rather than lifted-out. The K-RED 4-stage pipeline, two op21 fix-gates and single shared ROM are all faithfully present per the source, but material blending and the ungrounded plate cost legibility and geometric-fidelity points.
gaps: The v-path and w-path muxes described in compact_bf_v2 ('[mux sel]' before modular_mul and on the u_q5/add path) are collapsed into a single ntt_intt_mux; consider modeling the v-operand mux and the add-path op21 select mux as distinct small parts for full dataflow fidelity.

The PWM double-pass mode (stored 81^-1 = 11227 re-using the same K-RED unit) exists only in the control_fsm spec note, not as a visible feedback path; a thin copper return bus from kred_csub back to the multiplier input would depict it.
All logic blocks are boxes; the die floorplan is inherently rectilinear, but the ROM could use a taller distinct footprint to signal its 1023-word depth relative to the small DFF registers.

meta.before: Root everything on the PCB. Populate the board: a gold PCIe edge connector, the FPGA BGA package carrying the exposed silicon die, an in-package HBM stack on each side, a clock oscillator, two bulk decoupling caps and an auxiliary power tap; a brushed-steel heatsink base and fins cap the die. Directly above the die, an exploded logic-floorplan plate carries the synthesized CFNTT-KRED butterfly datapath (compact_bf_v2): two conflict-free memory banks with their address generators stream u/v coefficients into input DFFs, while a single shared 1023-word twiddle ROM (storing W = 9^-1·w) feeds the w delay chain. The K-RED modular multiplier is a 4-stage pipeline — ONE 14×14→28 hardware multiplier, then two shift-add fold stages (d = 3z+6q−z>>12; e = 3d+q−d>>12) and one conditional subtraction — producing 9·A·B mod q. A modular_add combines u with the product; two modular_half (op21) gates, one on the ROM output and one on the add path, derive the per-stage INTT halving that fixes the reference's 2^10-scaling bug, selected by the NTT/INTT mux. A control FSM sequences the banks, ROM addresses and the sel line; a copper datapath bus threads the stages.
